DURATION 15 SECONDS | HORIZONTAL 16:9

CHARACTER REFERENCES

{{CHAR_JAMSHID_WORKER}}  {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}  {{CHAR_GUARDS}}

LOCATION REFERENCES

{{LOC_COASTAL_RESIDENCE}}

PROP REFERENCES

{{PROP_ZAHHAK_STAFF}}  {{PROP_INDUSTRIAL_SAW}}  {{PROP_COLLECTION_OBJECTS}}

DIRECTION AND CONTINUITY

Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic sequence. Preserve each referenced identity, costume, proportions and rigid handmade mask; mask geometry and eye openings remain fixed. All visible humans wear their referenced masks. Emotion comes from posture, hands, breath and visible eyes. Each listed hard cut changes the physical camera station, lens or viewpoint. Handheld movement follows a possible path and recovers focus on essential action. References anchor design; written lighting controls illumination. Tactile modern Iranian mythological design, analog realism and natural imperfections. NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

Zahhak remains unhurried and indifferent. Whenever he walks, show the staff planting first, weight transferring onto it, then the weaker leg following in an uneven step. Preserve the reference's weak-leg side. His two single-headed shoulder snakes remain alive, making small independent movements; preserve their attachment and proportions.

LOCATION AND LIGHT

Night in ONE vast collection hall with a continuous flat floor. SOUTH entrance; NORTH balcony; objects arranged on low display furniture along the perimeter walls, with no readable labels. A real functional industrial timber saw stands in the CENTRAL floor area, not on a pedestal and not in a separate room. Its level feed carriage runs WEST to EAST toward the fixed blade at its EAST end; its controls are on the SOUTH side. The NORTH wall holds a display table just WEST of the balcony opening. Cold integrated ceiling light reveals the hall; small neutral display lights skim the perimeter objects; one harder neutral task lamp lights the saw. The north balcony has dim sea-sky fill and fixed rail lights. All sources stay steady. The saw is part of the working floor, not a museum exhibit.

START STATE AND BLOCKING

Zahhak faces the NORTH display with his back to Jamshid. Jamshid faces NORTH from SOUTHWEST of the idle central saw, A and B at his sides. C and D remain at the south entrance. The saw carriage runs west-east with blade EAST. No one has started the machine.


PLAN 09A | SHOTS

SHOT 09A-01 | 0s–3s | 3 SECONDS

50mm close handheld from WEST of Jamshid, his mask in north-facing profile. He tries one step toward Zahhak, lifts his chin and takes an urgent breath as if about to address him. A tightens his grip and stops the step. No intelligible speech; expectation is in his eyes and body.

SHOT 09A-02 | 3s–9s | 6 SECONDS

40mm calm from NORTHEAST of the display looking SOUTHWEST. Zahhak large foreground RIGHT, Jamshid small background LEFT. Zahhak keeps looking down at the object and his back remains toward Jamshid. His staff stays planted; he briefly raises his free hand and makes one dismissive indication toward the central saw. Within this SAME frame A and B immediately redirect Jamshid toward the WEST end of its carriage. Zahhak returns the free hand to the object without looking back.

SHOT 09A-03 | 9s–12s | 3 SECONDS

35mm close handheld from beside Jamshid's left shoulder, moving east with the forced escort. His legs go slack for a beat; his head remains turned north toward the display. He searches for a glance that never arrives. Short focus slip from sleeve to visible eye, then recover.

SHOT 09A-04 | 12s–15s | 3 SECONDS

50mm from SOUTHWEST of Jamshid, mask profile near frame LEFT, Zahhak's back distant toward NORTH. Guards pull Jamshid toward the carriage while Zahhak calmly sets an object down. Camera moves with Jamshid, refusing a reverse look from Zahhak.

END STATE AND EDIT

Jamshid reaches the WEST head end of the central carriage, still looking NORTH. A and B keep control. Zahhak finishes with the display and is about to move to the NORTH balcony via the clear perimeter aisle. Saw OFF.

SOUND

An attempted breath, sleeves tightening, shoes dragged on floor; quiet object contact remains unnervingly ordinary. No dialogue or music.

NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
